note: Prairie campground on the east shore of Eagle Lake east of Strathmore, at the former Eagle Lake Campground and across the road from the Rocking R Guest Ranch; also sells seasonal and a limited number of full-time sites. Public beach, boat launch and kayak, paddleboard and pedal-boat rentals; day visitors buy a day pass. --Claude
summary: Priced on Campspot (one night 2027-06-08): base C$30 (unserviced, 30-ft sites 90-91) to C$55 (50 A pull-through) plus C$5 booking fee and GST; season corrected to May 15-Oct 4 (was May 1-Sep 30, derived); 107 sites, pull-through 48 ft; sewer false (no septic dumping on sites); booking Campspot; note cleaned.
